narrative.intro: Fluor Marine Propulsion has $4B in federal contract obligations for FY2026 to date. Fluor Marine Propulsion received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, giving an average award size of $2B, and obligations are up 11.9% year over year. Department of Defense is the largest buyer, with the Department of Defense obligated $2B, followed by Department of Energy with Department of Energy obligated $1.9B. Fiscal-year obligations show a steady baseline: FY21 obligated $3.1B, FY22 obligated $3.6B, FY23 obligated $3.5B, FY24 obligated $3.5B, FY25 obligated $3.6B, and FY26 obligated $4B. Current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is fiscal year to date. The mix of two very large awards produced the high average award size and the year-over-year increase. Contractors and partners should focus on large-order execution and compliance while tracking agency-specific requirements at the Department of Defense and the Department of Energy, which together account for the majority of FY2026 obligations.
